claim_1.claim: ELISA analysis of serum from 30 healthy young adults immunized with either MCV4 (n=17) or MPSV4 (n=13) showed that polysaccharide-specific IgG binding antibody responses against meningococcal serogroups A and C peaked at day 30 for MCV4 and day 180 for MPSV4, with a greater magnitude and duration of response in MPSV4 compared to MCV4.

sources.section: Antibody responses induced by meningococcal vaccines
sources.quote: Both vaccines induced robust polysaccharide-specific IgG binding antibody responses against serogroups A and C, as measured by ELISA. These responses peaked at day 30 (MCV4) or day 180 (MPSV4) ( Fig. 1a ). The magnitude and duration of the polysaccharide-specific IgG response was greater with MPSV4 compared to a single dose of MCV4 ( Fig. 1a ).

comparison.finding: polysaccharide-specific IgG binding antibody responses peaked at day 30 for MCV4 and day 180 for MPSV4, with a greater magnitude and duration of response in MPSV4 compared to MCV4

claim_2.claim: Luminex xMAP analysis of serum from MCV4 vaccinees showed a strong anti-DT IgG response at days 7 and 30, whereas MPSV4 did not induce an anti-DT IgG response.

sources.section: Antibody responses induced by meningococcal vaccines
sources.quote: MCV4, which contains the diphtheria toxoid (DT) protein as a conjugate, elicited a strong anti-DT IgG response at days 7 and 30, whereas MPSV4 containing polysaccharide alone did not ( Fig. 1e ).

comparison.finding: MCV4 elicited a strong anti-DT IgG response at day 7, whereas MPSV4 did not
MCV4 elicited a strong anti-DT IgG response at day 30, whereas MPSV4 did not

claim_3.claim: Flow Cytometry analysis of blood from MCV4 and MPSV4 vaccinees showed that the number of peripheral blood antibody secreting cells (ASCs) peaked at day 7, with a higher magnitude of ASC response in MCV4 compared to MPSV4.

sources.section: Antibody responses induced by meningococcal vaccines
sources.quote: The number of peripheral blood antibody secreting cells (ASCs) induced by vaccination was assessed. The ASCs showed a peak at day 7 in both vaccines ( Fig. 1f ). Surprisingly, even though a greater polysaccharide-specific antibody response was induced by MPSV4 ( Fig. 1a, d ), the magnitude of the ASC response induced by MPSV4 was lower than that induced by MCV4 ( Fig. 1f ).

comparison.finding: higher magnitude of ASC response in MCV4 compared to MPSV4

claim_4.claim: Transcription profiling by array of PBMCs from MCV4 vaccinees showed 1,150 differentially expressed genes at day 7 post-vaccination, with a transcriptional network regulated by XBP1, whereas only a small number of DEGs were identified at day 3 post-vaccination for both MPSV4 and MCV4, and at day 7 for MPSV4.

sources.section: Workflow to compare vaccine transcriptomic signatures
sources.quote: At day 7 post-vaccination, we identified 1,150 differentially expressed genes (DEGs) in MCV4 vaccinees ( Fig. 2a ). These DEGs bear the hallmark of antibody secreting cells (ASC), which is consistent with the enhanced frequencies of these cells ( Fig. 1f ).

sources.section: Workflow to compare vaccine transcriptomic signatures
sources.quote: However, only a small number of DEGs were identified at day 3 post-vaccination for both MPSV4 and MCV4, and at day 7 for MPSV4 ( Fig. 2a ).

comparison.finding: 1,150 differentially expressed genes at day 7 post-vaccination in MCV4
only a small number of DEGs identified at day 7 for MPSV4
